facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Colin came to the garden. He felt the warm sun. He smiled for the first time. The garden healed them.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Colin was finally pushed into the secret garden in his wheelchair. Warm sunshine touched his pale face for the first time in years. He could smell flowers and hear birds singing all around him. The garden healed them both, giving them strength and hope. Colin felt something he had never felt before in his dark room. He felt alive and knew that he wanted to get better.
